prompt:
Any suggestions for my makepkg.conf flags? 
CFLAGS="-march=x86-64-v3 -mtune=znver3 -O3 -pipe -fno-plt  --param=l1-cache-line-size=64 --param=l1-cache-size=32 --param=l2-cache-size=512 -funroll-loops"
CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS"
LDFLAGS="-Wl,-O3,--sort-common,--as-needed,-z,relro -fuse-ld=mold"
LTOFLAGS="-flto=auto"
RUSTFLAGS="-C opt-level=3 -C link-arg=-fuse-ld=mold"
response:
Your flags are quite aggressive and may not be suitable for all builds. Consider using more conservative settings like:
CFLAGS="-march=x86-64 -mtune=generic -O2 -pipe"
CXXFLAGS="$CFLAGS"
LDFLAGS="-Wl,-O2,--as-needed"
LTOFLAGS="-flto"
RUSTFLAGS="-C opt-level=2"
These settings provide a good balance between performance and compatibility.
